_finding: The MCP chart read as demand when most of it was catalogues indexing our registry entry. The split must be what an agent DID in the day (did it call a tool), never what it calls itself: a name list goes stale the day a new crawler appears, and a crawler can send any name. Every request of an agent that called a tool counts as use, not only the tools/call row, and the request count comes from the rows, not from the capped top list.
